entities.summary: Kenneth "Trey" Murphy III is an American professional basketball player for the New Orleans Pelicans of the National Basketball Association (NBA). He played college basketball for the Rice Owls and the Virginia Cavaliers. With Virginia, he became the most recent Men's NCAA basketball player to post a 50–40–90 season, with a 50–43–93 tally in the 2020–21 season.
